howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你如何为 nullable-request-body 命令行工具添加自定义命令。它会教你编辑 custom.rs 文件注册新命令，并使用 SDK 客户端执行操作。
howto.when: 当你询问如何编写或添加自定义命令时触发，例如问“怎么自定义 nullable-request-body 命令？”。

say.text: 怎么给 nullable-request-body 加一个自定义命令？
如何注册一个名为 test-method-name 的命令？

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can guide you on how to add custom commands to the nullable-request-body CLI. It will show you how to edit the custom.rs file to register new commands and use the SDK client to execute operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about authoring or adding custom commands, e.g., "How to customize nullable-request-body commands?".

say_en.text: How can I add a custom command to nullable-request-body?
How to register a command named test-method-name?
